reports.title: ENACT REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS; ANNOUNCES $0.24 QUARTERLY DIVIDEND

lines: Increased Full-Year Capital Return Guidance to approximately $600 million

•We now anticipate a total 2026 capital return of approximately $600 million reflecting our continued strong financial position and confidence in our business; the final amount and form of capital returned to shareholders will depend on business performance, market conditions, and regulatory approval
